quests.title: Recollections of a Fontainian

dialogue.t: A-Achoo! The smell of these spices is just too... A-ACHOO!
I should just take a picture and go hide in my room...
Traveler! Hey! Traveler! Hold on a second!

dialogue.sit: What can I do for you?

dialogue.t: I'd like your help with taking a picture, just one. It won't take long.
*sigh* It's embarrassing to admit, but the aroma of the spices here is a little too strong for me...
During my time in Fontaine, I never had food with even just a hint of spiciness, a pinch of salt is as much as I can take.
Here, I'm sneezing so much that— ACHOO! I can't even hold the Kamera steadily...
So, all I can do... is ask someone else to take a photo for me.
You certainly seem to be a kind person, so... I'd like to ask for your help.
Indeed. I'm very sorry that I forgot to introduce myself...
I'm Augustus Lovelace, a researcher from Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering.

dialogue.sit: Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering?
What kind of place is that?

dialogue.t: It's a mouthful, isn't it? You can call it the Fontaine Research Institute, as most people in Fontaine do.
The Fontaine Research Institute used to be a paradise for researchers in Fontaine and where most mechanical creations originated.
But thanks to Mr. Edwin, most buildings in the Fontaine Research Institute are lying in ruin now...
And ever since Raimondo and Mr. Choiseul took over the reconstruction project, the spirit of research at the institute has been in freefall.
I have standards and prefer a tidy environment. I refuse to live in a pile of rubble, and so I've been traveling around.
Don't let my troubles spoil your mood, they have nothing to do with you.
Come on, please hurry and snap a photo for me. Once Xavier sees the beauty of Sumeru, there's no way he'll stay in Inazuma!
Xavier is a researcher from the Fontaine Research Institute. We used to work in the same laboratory, and he once gave me quite a bit of help.
He insisted on shooting a film and being the director. That wasn't a very popular idea in Fontaine Research Institute at the time.
Even after being assigned to other projects, he still continued shooting "dokumentari films" in the name of recording their research process.
Just like that, he went back and forth between projects and the laboratory until he was finally sent to Inazuma...

He's a very resourceful person. I'm certain that had he been born in the past, when funding was abundant and more fields of research were accepted, or been born in a brighter future, he would have accomplished great things...
That's enough of that. Come and take a photo of me. Right here will do.

dialogue.sit: How did you get to know Xavier?

dialogue.t: You... Whoa! Are you the Traveler that Xavier told me about?
A pleasure! It's truly an honor to meet you! I've read all about your heroic feats in the Mikage Furnace from Xavier's letters.
And whenever Xavier talks about films in his letters, he always mentions your extraordinary acting skills!
He says you're fearless, noble, and most importantly, you have a great sense of humor!
Oh, once you've taken the photo, you must give me your autograph. It would be perfect if you signed the photo!

dialogue.sit: How is Xavier doing these days?

dialogue.t: Well, to be honest... not great. He's anxious about his film, and based on his letters, he has been having trouble finding an interesting new subject lately.
I suggested that he should do as I did and take some time off in Sumeru.
But he keeps insisting that he must shoot the best possible film for the Yashiro Commission, and he refuses to leave Inazuma until it's done.
That's enough of that. Come and take a photo of me. Right here will do.
Have you taken my picture?
Oh, take your time. Taking a good photo is no easy task.
Not bad indeed. You have a gift.
It's the first time in my travels that I've met someone with such control over composition and color.

dialogue.sit: Where have your travels taken you?

dialogue.t: Ah, that, well... I could have come directly to Sumeru from Fontaine... after all, there's a line going straight to the Bayda Harbor in Sumeru.
But as they say, it's about the journey, not the destination. So I chose a... more interesting route.
First, I went from Lumidouce Harbor to Chenyu Vale, and then passed through Qingce Village on my way to the Stone Gate that separates Mondstadt from Liyue.
After stopping by Dawn Winery, I decided to head south and visit Liyue Harbor.
I embarked on a ferry to Port Ormos from Liyue Harbor, traveled northward along the river, and here I am standing before you.
After all, my goal is to relax. Were I a brave warrior with a passion for adventure...
...I might have decided to set out from Romaritime Harbor and followed the ancient path of the pilgrims, heading southward into the desert.
Who knows? Maybe I'll try to cross the desert on the way back. Anyway, I've still got extra Mora to spend, and paying a visit to Natlan on the other side of the desert sounds nice too...
Alright, I won't keep you any longer. Thank you for helping me with the photo, please accept this as a token of my gratitude.
I'm off to write to Xavier. If he still won't come to Sumeru, then I might as well go back to Fontaine...

quests.description: You encounter an anxious man from Fontaine in Sumeru City…
